message.reasoning_content: Key risk: catastrophic cancellation. Anchors are query + noise(0.015625); query ~16. Anchor norms ~16²·32≈8192, dot ~8192, differences ~32·0.015625²≈0.0078. float32 rounding at ~8192 magnitude has ulp ~0.00098 (2^13, ulp 2^-10≈0.000977), so cancellation error per accumulated term could be significant vs distance ~0.008. Accumulators round to float32 each step: relative error ~2^-24 of 8192 → ~0.0005 per step, sum over 32 steps could be ~0.003-0.01, comparable to distance itself. Weights exp(-16·d): d≈0.008, so weights ~0.88; error in d of ±0.01 changes weight by ~16%. That likely shifts the weighted prediction noticeably — but since all weights similar, normalized prediction may be robust. Record description.
